operations.notes: Drop+recreate, migrate, 1000 entities + ~2.5k memories + 3.2k facts + 10 bridge pairs, real updateEntityMeta per entity, pg_dump --format=plain (deterministic), strip header timestamp, write ground_truth.json. §5.1 has no explicit 1k generate threshold; this is the baseline regression line.
sha256 hash of the 10.5 MB plain dump. Comfortably under the §5.1 target.

Drop+recreate, preload extensions, psql apply (plain), row-count check. Above the <1s target but within the 3s hard cap. Plain-format apply via psql is unavoidably slower than custom-format pg_restore; the trade-off favours determinism (cold-eyes review B6 / §4.2 invariant). Optimisation deferred until a Phase 1 consumer needs it.
Both cognitive.dump (109 MB) and ground_truth.json (7.5 KB) hash-match the manifest's expected_hashes. Verifies determinism contract holds across regenerations.
Above the <5s target but within the 15s hard cap. Same plain-format trade-off as 1k. Optimisation candidate for j77.4 if a benchmark consumer breaches the cap.

disk_size.notes: 10k dump (104 MB) is over the §5.1 <50 MB target but well under the 200 MB hard cap. Plain-format dump is roughly 2x larger than custom would be; the determinism trade-off is still worth it.
